about: Donations to the Kessen Chess charities made somewhere other than a Kessen fundraiser page (for example on the charity's own website). Only add an entry after checking a receipt. The game adds these on top of each fundraiser page's live total, so never list a donation that was made through a fundraiser page.

format.abn: the charity's ABN, e.g. 89 067 251 209 (Foodbank Queensland). Smile Train has no ABN, so gifts to it can't be listed here
format.amount: a number in Australian dollars, e.g. 25
format.receipt: where the receipt can be seen (optional), e.g. a redacted image in this repository
